capabilities: Toggle borderless mode per tab from the pane menu or command palette
Remove borders, outlines, and shadows from tab content
Hide the tab strip and view header with hover reveal
Configure animation, hover reveal, and hidden elements in settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the borderless setting resets when the tab is closed.
problem: Obsidian always draws tab borders, outlines, and the tab header with title and navigation controls, and offers no per-tab way to hide them.
summary: Per-tab toggle that removes borders, shadows, and the tab strip or view header from an open tab for a chrome-free view.
